subject.title: fix(cron): honor explicit announce delivery on system-event jobs

question: Should an unpinned `systemEvent` carrying announce delivery be implicitly rewritten into an isolated `agentTurn`, or should callers be required to submit an isolated agent-turn job explicitly?
rationale: The current public shape treats system events and isolated agent turns as distinct execution contracts, and the PR changes that distinction rather than repairing an established successful behavior.

options.title: Require explicit isolated agent turns
options.body: Keep the current rejection but improve the error or calling surface so scheduled channel notifications are created as `agentTurn` plus `sessionTarget: "isolated"`.

options.title: Adopt the implicit conversion
options.body: Accept the new convenience behavior, document the semantic conversion, and prove both explicit-target and inherited-session delivery paths.

recommendation.title: Require explicit isolated agent turns
recommendation.body: Keep the current rejection but improve the error or calling surface so scheduled channel notifications are created as `agentTurn` plus `sessionTarget: "isolated"`.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the clearest history-backed owner of the existing cron delivery guard and resolver behavior.
